mapper.insert: INSERT INTO refund (order_id, ticket_id, refund_amount, fee, reason, operator_id, biz_type) VALUES (#{orderId}, #{ticketId}, #{refundAmount}, #{fee}, #{reason}, #{operatorId}, COALESCE(#{bizType}, 'REFUND'))
mapper.select: SELECT id, order_id, ticket_id, refund_amount, fee, reason, refund_time, operator_id, biz_type FROM refund WHERE order_id = #{orderId} ORDER BY refund_time
